access.notes: Open-source DFT package with pw.x and ph.x modules for relaxations and phonon calculations.
Curated library of PBE-based PAW pseudopotentials compatible with Quantum ESPRESSO.
Monoclinic M1 (space group P21/c) and rutile R (space group P42/mnm) structures with known lattice parameters. Available in public crystallographic databases such as COD or ICSD.
Optional tool for finite-displacement phonon calculations; the built-in DFPT of Quantum ESPRESSO can also be used.
